title: 4 Bank Stocks That Deliver Retirees Dependable Passive Income
summary: One bank cut its payout to a dime, another raised it 18%, and a third has not budged in years. Retirees chasing quarterly income will want to see which big lenders earn their checks and where the hidden risks sit.

title: 5 Banks With Dependable Passive Income Dividends That Could Prosper as Rates Rise
summary: Every one of these five bank stocks slashed its dividend in the financial crisis, yet a new rate cycle may be rewarding patient holders. Only one has stopped raising its payout, and another carries a hidden capital risk worth knowing about.

title: The Technical Signals Behind (PNC) That Institutions Follow - Stock Traders Daily
M&T Bank Just Raised Its Dividend 20% as Earnings Support a Bigger Payout
summary: M&T's board just handed shareholders a much bigger check, and the earnings and capital numbers back it up. Still, shrinking margins and rising charge-offs hint at where the next test could come from, and rivals took very different paths.

title: Will KeyCorp's Investment in MMG Strengthen Its Real Estate Business?
summary: KEY's investment in MMG aims to integrate multifamily investment sales and financing. This will expand its commercial real estate reach and revenue opportunities.
